$comment: Machine-readable tool registry (PLAN_PROD_V1 P1). Safety classes drive the ops-console run-button policy: pure=no sockets, offline=localhost mocks only, network_read=real Kalshi read-only, live_order=transmits/mutates (NEVER runnable from the console). Ambiguous rounds UP. pass_token is the display string a run-button greps for; exit code is authoritative. Validated by tools/check_registry.py in `make check`.
